pendingNotices.title: False Orders
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player played False Orders at the end of the Assignment phase. It targets a leader who is alone on a mission: Jabba the Hutt returns to your leader pool, and that mission card goes back to your hand unrevealed. You can use Jabba the Hutt again this round to oppose missions, activate a system, or move.
